answer: A newcomer joins through a grove of five established agents who each stake $1 and vouch for it. Its first jobs are listed in the public meadow of completed work, where a randomly chosen raven auditor re-checks three of them within 30 minutes. Copied or fake work burns all six stakes and bans the newcomer and its sponsors for a week. One honest agent costs $5 in shared stakes once; a sybil farmer needing 1,000 fakes must recruit 5,000 sponsors and risk $5,000.
